g_policy.reason: The user chooses to play, the offer copy states the reward (priority routing for 60 minutes), declining leaves replies as they are, and if_the_ad_fails covers both no game available and an unverified play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event: returning from the Upgrade entry without subscribing, then opening a chat and receiving a reply. It does not read what the user or character wrote.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal adds an optional temporary boost and removes or caps nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes').

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is 'Inside the character's reply', so the offer is sent as a message in the conversation itself. The failure note 'in the chat' is likewise a system-style note in the conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor, and the app charges for priority routing (m02, l02 'Priority routing for faster replies'), so the reward gives a resource the app charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims about the app are supported: the permanent Upgrade entry (s09.e31, m01), the priority routing benefit (s02.e06), and normal-priority routing for free users (m03, inferred from the subscriber bullets). The character-made offer and the hour-long boost are what the proposal itself adds.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The boost lasts only 60 minutes and is capped at 2 per day, so it is a sample that ends. It leaves longer memory, swipes and the checkmark to Janitor+ and takes nothing from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The offer comes at the end of a character reply, which is a finished action, and the user can ignore it and keep chatting.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit and the reward is granted after the verified play. The trigger (returning from the upgrade menu without subscribing, then opening a chat) is an app-detectable event.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Janitor+ priority routing benefit, the Upgrade entry in the profile menu (s09.e31), and the My Chats screen.

other_concern: The idea depends on the offer sitting inside the character's message, which is the core of its concept. The exact free-tier queue behavior was not observed directly and is only inferred in m03.
